title: Eleanor & Park
author: Rainbow Rowell
summary: In 1986 Omaha, two sixteen-year-old misfits sit together on the school bus and slowly bond over comics and mixtapes. Their first love is complicated by unkind classmates and Eleanor's unsafe home.
readIf: you want a tender first-love story with real sadness and wonderful music and nerd references.
skipIf: you are uncomfortable with depictions of an abusive home.

pairings.reason: A funnier, more hopeful teen romance with the same warm, observant voice.
Another slow, tender coming-of-age love story set before smartphones.
A sweeter, more glamorous version of a teen romance built on friendship and longing.
